name: Daily Inbox Summary

schedule.timezone_note: Cron runs in UTC. 14:00 UTC = 9am EST (winter) / 10am EDT (summer). Mon-Fri only.

notes: The prompt is stored alongside this file as prompt.md. To recreate the routine via the RemoteTrigger API, inline prompt.md's contents at job_config.ccr.events[0].data.message.content and generate a fresh lowercase v4 UUID for events[0].data.uuid.
Microsoft 365 connector currently exposes read-only mail tools (outlook_email_search). No send-email step is in this routine — output lands in the ai-reports repo as a PR for review.
